statusSemantics.implemented: Executable code exists; does not imply live verification.
statusSemantics.passed: Specified local evidence passed; platform/scope limits remain explicit.
statusSemantics.partial: Only part of criterion or verification matrix is covered.
statusSemantics.blocked: External target/access or unimplemented dependent fixture prevents verification.
statusSemantics.retired: Removed from current product scope by the 2026-09-23 current-session requirement; historical evidence is not current verification.

criteria.criterion: Native Codex package declares the native manifest, skill/MCP paths and exclusive Codex product routing
The Codex host lists the plugin and supports enable/disable without a manual skills-only installation
criteria.blocker: Verified only on Codex 0.154.0 macOS arm64; portable MCP not discovered.

criteria.criterion: MCP runs from the native installation location outside the monorepo
The primary bootstrap installs client dependencies and registers the plugin without manual JSON/TOML edits
criteria.blocker: macOS client path exercised; Linux/Windows/WSL2 not executed. Project-only Codex scope is blocked.

criteria.criterion: Repeated setup is idempotent; interruptions recover and concurrent setup is protected
criteria.blocker: Same-host dead lock recovery and repeated offline setup tested; bootstrap interruption/upgrade matrix on all OSes remains incomplete.

criteria.criterion: Download integrity failure blocks execution; offline/cache misses do not conceal network requests
criteria.blocker: Vendor/browser network channels still require per-platform clean-machine evidence; Playwright browser payload integrity is delegated to Playwright.

criteria.criterion: Existing Codex settings, Java/Node runtimes and unrelated plugins are preserved
criteria.blocker: Unrelated Codex setting and reused runtimes checked; foreign plugin and every upgrade/failure path require additional fixture coverage.

criteria.criterion: The new-app template passes real Oracle compiler validation
Existing-app export/adopt preserves local edits and application components
criteria.blocker: Local edit preservation is covered by unit fixtures. Actual existing-app no-op export/import and page/LOV preservation evidence is not included; normalization/component fixtures remain incomplete.

criteria.criterion: `.apex` metadata/MMD are preserved; unsupported capabilities are not simulated
criteria.blocker: Real compiler validation retains template MMD metadata. Existing-app metadata/component preservation and unsupported-component rejection matrix remain unverified.

criteria.criterion: Source mutation after planning and target drift block apply
criteria.blocker: Source and target-drift behavior tested with fixtures; actual DB drift requires an authorized target.

criteria.criterion: Target DB/service/workspace/schema/application ID are verified before writes
criteria.blocker: Fresh target identity and mismatch failures are covered by unit fixtures. Actual connected pre-write/post-write checks and the full negative matrix remain unverified.

criteria.criterion: An existing-app backup is created and verified before import; restore uses a separate plan
criteria.blocker: Backup-before-import ordering is covered by unit fixtures. Actual Oracle backup, restore and restore-failure evidence remains open.

criteria.criterion: Migration checksums and journals work without blind reapplication
criteria.blocker: Default local checksum/history persistence, started-before-execution and interruption protection passed in fixtures. Actual Oracle DDL interruption/reconciliation remains unverified; database journal mode is optional.

criteria.criterion: Concurrent deployments from different runners to the same target are coordinated
criteria.blocker: Separate Node runner contention is covered by local fixtures within one managed home/schema. Independent homes/machines require external serialization or optional DB control; real distributed Oracle contention remains unverified.

criteria.criterion: Timeout, cancellation and disconnect handling preserve `outcome_unknown` and support reconciliation
criteria.blocker: Timeout/unknown write state tested with fixtures and real subprocess timeout; real DB disconnect/process-tree termination and reconciliation matrix incomplete.

criteria.criterion: An agent cannot authorize production by setting `approved=true` itself
criteria.blocker: Strict schema and missing production authority rejection tested. Protected-runner signature/approval integration is not configured.

criteria.criterion: The utPLSQL suite returns real results; a missing framework does not count as passed
criteria.blocker: No real utPLSQL suite result is included. An authorized integration target with utPLSQL is required; empty or blocked required suites fail the quality gate.

criteria.criterion: Browser E2E proves authenticated CRUD and negative validation, beyond HTTP 200
criteria.blocker: Authenticated CRUD, negative validation and mobile breakpoint verification require an authorized integration target and authenticated browser profile; no executed application browser evidence is included.

criteria.criterion: An empty, skipped or blocked required suite fails the quality gate
Secrets are absent from Git, process arguments, MCP output, logs and public artifacts
criteria.blocker: Credential references, private auth, redaction and bundle scan verified locally. No claim of exhaustive business-secret detection or full live trace audit.

criteria.criterion: CLI and MCP apply policy and error classification consistently
Update/uninstall preserves user projects, backups and unrelated configurations
criteria.blocker: Product uninstall checked in clean profile; full cross-version/platform update/rollback coverage incomplete.

criteria.criterion: GitHub artifacts and the apex.rest site build have matching versions and checksums
criteria.blocker: Local artifact/site versions and checksums verified. Public GitHub source distribution is available; no signed GitHub release or apex.rest site deployment is claimed.

criteria.criterion: Broad native-platform and Oracle integration qualification remains blocked when required source-bound evidence is missing; npm distribution is recorded separately
Documentation distinguishes verified, experimental and planned capabilities and platform profiles
Startup does not load the complete Oracle manual, schema or traces into context
A sandbox labelled supported actually provisions the stack and preserves data during ordinary `down`
criteria.blocker: No supported sandbox claim. Legitimate complete Linux DB/APEX/ORDS/utPLSQL provisioning tuple is not implemented or verified.

criteria.blocker: Current local checks are recorded separately from historical desktop observations; no new Oracle deployment observation or broader platform rendering is implied.

criteria.criterion: Retired: plugin task startup, model routing and team wait lifecycle
criteria.historicalCriterion: Codex chat executes single work in the current user session without a new agent or polling; explicitly enabled teams retain in-app panels, automatic model routing and digest-checked results through bounded waiting

criteria.criterion: Plugin-level ORDS HTTP(S) transport preserves APEXlang import/export and direct connection settings without requiring SQLcl saved OREST connections

Application browser verification is explicitly deferred by the user. Native-host settings evidence is separate from connected CLI operation evidence.

criteria.criterion: Retired: dual single/team modes and Settings opt-in
criteria.historicalCriterion: Single mode reuses the current Codex session across chat, CLI/MCP and panel handoffs with no new agent or App Server; queued legacy single requests cannot dispatch workers, while teams require explicit Settings opt-in

criteria.criterion: Reduce plugin instruction/catalog context, reuse fresh reference normalization and wait for existing jobs within one bounded MCP call without changing authorization, outcomes or effective input constraints
criteria.blocker: Local byte and retrieval measurements plus isolated runtime tests only. End-to-end native APEX task latency, Oracle performance and billed-token savings remain unmeasured.

criteria.criterion: Deterministic Oracle/APEX operations return completed jobs in one bounded call, batch scoped metadata with one target verification and provide concise project inspection while preserving outcomes and recovery
criteria.blocker: Local stdio MCP, CLI, synthetic nonempty test workers and mocked metadata adapter only. Native Codex end-to-end task latency, Oracle execution and billed-token savings are unmeasured.

criteria.criterion: All APEXREST implementation runs directly in the current Codex conversation; no plugin model-session controller, team/work startup APIs, team skills, model routing or task controls remain in the executable package
criteria.blocker: Local source, CLI/MCP/package and UI checks do not establish live Oracle behavior, native task latency or paid-token savings.
